name: Tsukushite Ageru no! ~Datte Onii-chan no Oyome-san ni Naritain da Mon~
original_name: つくしてあげるの！～だっておにいちゃんのおよめさんになりたいんだもん～
source:
Main character is a student who suddenly gets assaulted by many girls who he promised marriage as a child. Girls decide to choose the bride in a fair competition.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名学生，突然遭到许多女孩包围；他小时候曾分别答应与她们结婚。女孩们决定通过公平竞争选出新娘。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
